message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current exchange rate, which fluctuates daily. As a rough estimate based on recent market rates (about 1 USD ≈ 0.78 GBP), $20 would be roughly **£15.60**.  

For an exact figure you’d want to check a reliable financial source or a currency‑conversion tool at the time of your transaction.
